scope: Independent source review of synchronization, allocation lifetime, all exits and restoration; no hardware or NVCC execution
limitations: If CUDA synchronization fails, main records the failure and still attempts bounded guarded restoration; DevSta Transactions Pending covers nonposted requests, not proof of complete GPU idleness. Such a run is aborted and cannot be a valid comparison.
SIGKILL or a fatal process/kernel failure cannot run userspace restoration; the native wrapper/reboot is the outer recovery path.
The mutable attributes are NoSnoop and RelaxedOrdering together (mask0x0810), so a changed outcome cannot isolate the two bits individually.
CPU BAR diagnostics can SKIP on missing trace/identity; their status remains separate from numerical P2P outcomes.
